just-black.$description: Just Black — Page canvas, footer surface, deep section backgrounds

surface-cream.$description: Surface Cream — Primary text, outlined button borders, nav links, card text, the default surface-light used for ghost controls and headings

surface-50.$description: Surface 50 — Muted secondary text, icon fills at rest, subhead annotations, disabled-state labels

surface-25.$description: Surface 25 — Hairline borders, dividers, low-contrast outlines against the black canvas

off-black.$description: Off Black — Alternative dark surface for nested panels and code blocks

shockingly-green.$description: Shockingly Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

light-green.$description: Light Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

orangey.$description: Orangey — SVG category label, orange-tool icon fills, gradient endpoint in Orange Crush

pink.$description: Pink — Scroll category label, decorative splashes, gradient endpoint in Summer Fair

lilac.$description: Lilac — Text category label, thin illustrative strokes, gradient endpoint in Purple Haze

blue.$description: Blue — UI category label, gradient endpoint in Skyfall and Emerald City

core-green.$description: Core Green — Subtle brand-tinted background washes for feature cards tied to the GSAP core

lipstick-pink.$description: Lipstick Pink — Deep gradient stop for expressive decorative gradients, not used for text or UI

mori.$description: Single-family system. Mori weight 600 at 224px with lh 0.9 and -0.02em tracking is the hero display; the same family at weight 400 body sizes carries every paragraph, label, and nav item. The custom face carries a slightly humanist warmth in the cream rendering that a geometric grotesque (Inter, Manrope) cannot replicate, so substitute with a humanist sans (e.g. Inter Tight or Söhne) and accept a tighter, colder fallback.
